title: 第1章 师尊，你检查就检查，脱衣服干嘛
novel_title: 修炼就修炼，你们别总想留宿啊
content_zh:
林尘，苍梧宗外门弟子，炼气三层。

    这修为低到什么程度呢。

    前几天宗门那只灵犬从他旁边路过，闻了闻，嫌弃地走了。

    没错，连狗都嫌。

    “林尘！你他娘的又在偷懒！”

    外门管事赵长老的声音从后面炸过来。

    “人家都在修炼，你搁这儿晒太阳？”

    林尘躺在青石台阶上，懒洋洋睁开一只眼。

    “赵老，我这不就是在修炼吗。”

    “你管晒太阳叫修炼？”

    “吸收日月精华啊，书上说的。”

    赵长老气得胡子翘起来。

    “滚去后山砍柴！今天砍不够十捆不许吃饭！”

    林尘慢悠悠爬起来，拍拍屁股往后山走。

    砍柴就砍柴呗，反正修炼也没用。

    他这体质不知道出了什么毛病，别人修炼一天顶他一个月。

    炼气三层，还是靠宗门每年发的丹药硬堆上来的。

    三年前入宗的时候测过资质，结果是下等——灵力亲和度低得离谱，经脉比正常人窄三分之一。

    当时负责测试的长老看了结果，只说了四个字：杂役的命。

    果然，三年下来跟他同期入宗的弟子最少也是炼气六层，有几个天赋好的已经筑基了。

    只有他还在炼气三层晃荡。

    外门杂役里比他修为低的，大概就只剩那几个刚入宗的小孩了。

    每天早上天不亮起来挑水劈柴，上午去演武场打扫，下午才能挤出一点时间打坐修炼。

    三年下来，修炼没长进，手上的老茧倒是厚了不少。

    后山安静，没人。

    林尘砍了两捆柴，找了块石头坐下歇着。

    正发呆呢，脑子里突然炸开一道声音。

    “叮！双修辅助系统正在绑定……”

    “10%……30%……70%……100%！”

    “绑定成功！”

    林尘愣了。

    “卧槽？”

    “宿主：林尘。修为：炼气三层。体质：混沌圣体（未觉醒）。”

    “系统功能：与宿主双修的女修将获得修为暴涨、瓶颈松动、暗伤痊愈等增益效果。同时，宿主将获得对方当前修为10%的反哺。”

    林尘盯着眼前浮现的半透明面板，心跳猛地加速。

    系统。

    双修辅助系统。

    这他娘的是让他当辅助。

    他在外门混了三年，听过不少弟子吹牛说哪天捡到上古传承一夜逆袭，没想到这种事真能轮到自己头上。

    只不过这传承的方式跟他想象的有点不太一样。

    “双修”两个字在他脑子里转了两圈，总觉得这系统不太正经。

    哪有正经系统专门帮人双修的。

    但转念一想，反正是白捡的金手指，不正经就不正经吧。

    再怎么说也是系统，总比继续当废物强。

    “检测到附近存在高契合度目标——玉玲珑，契合度91%。建议宿主尽快与之双修。”

    玉玲珑。

    那不是苍梧宗的内门长老吗。

    金丹后期的修为，在整个下三州都排得上号。

    更关键的是，她是他的师尊。

    虽然是记名的。

    当初他被分到她门下的时候，她看了他一眼，只说了一句话。

    “炼气三层？自己去藏书阁看书吧，别来烦我。”

    从那以后，他名义上是她弟子，实际上连她面都见不着。

    现在系统让他去跟她双修。
content_en:
Lin Chen, an outer disciple of Cangwu Sect, is at the third level of Qi Refining.

    How low is this level of cultivation?

    The sect's spirit dog passed by him a few days ago, sniffed it, and left in disgust.

    Yes, even dogs dislike it.

    "Lin Chen! You are fucking lazy again!"

    The voice of Elder Zhao, the outer steward, came from behind.

    "Everyone is practicing cultivation, but you're just sitting here to bask in the sun?"

    Lin Chen lay on the bluestone steps and opened one eye lazily.

    "Mr. Zhao, aren't I just practicing?"

    "You call sunbathing practice?"

    "Absorb the essence of the sun and the moon, it says in the book."

    Elder Zhao was so angry that his beard stood up.

    "Go to the back mountain to chop firewood! If you don't chop ten bundles today, you won't be allowed to eat!"

    Lin Chen slowly got up, patted his butt and walked towards the back mountain.

    If you want to chop wood, just chop wood. It’s useless to practice anyway.

    I don't know what's wrong with his physique, but one day of cultivation for others is as good as his for a month.

    The third level of Qi refining was achieved by relying on the pills distributed by the sect every year.

    When I joined the sect three years ago, my qualifications were tested, and the result was inferior - my spiritual affinity was extremely low, and my meridians were one-third narrower than those of normal people.

    The elder in charge of the test at that time looked at the results and said only four words: the life of the handyman.

    Sure enough, the disciples who joined the sect at the same time as him in the past three years were at least the sixth level of Qi refining, and a few of them with good talent had already established their foundation.

    He was the only one still hanging around on the third level of Qi Refining.

    Among the servants in the outer sect, the only ones with a lower level of cultivation than him were probably the few children who had just joined the sect.

    Every morning, I get up before dawn to fetch water and chop firewood. In the morning, I go to the martial arts field to clean up, and in the afternoon I can squeeze out some time to meditate and practice.

    After three years, I have not made any progress in my cultivation, but the calluses on my hands have become much thicker.

    The back mountain is quiet and no one is around.

    Lin Chen chopped two bundles of firewood and found a stone to sit down and rest.

    While I was in a daze, a voice suddenly exploded in my head.

    "Ding! The dual cultivation auxiliary system is being bound..."

    "10%...30%...70%...100%!"

    "Binding successful!"

    Lin Chen was stunned.

    "What the hell?"

    "Host: Lin Chen. Cultivation: third level of Qi refining. Physique: Chaos Holy Body (not awakened)."

    "System function: The female cultivator who practices dual cultivation with the host will receive benefits such as a surge in cultivation, loosening of bottlenecks, and healing of hidden injuries. At the same time, the host will receive 10% of the other party's current cultivation in return."

    Lin Chen stared at the translucent panel that appeared in front of him, his heart beating rapidly.

    system.

    Dual repair auxiliary system.

    Damn let him be an assistant.

    He had been working in the outer sect for three years and had heard many disciples bragging about picking up ancient inheritance and making a counterattack overnight. He never thought that such a thing would really happen to him.

    It's just that the way of inheritance is a little different from what he imagined.

    The word "double cultivation" ran around in his mind twice, and he always felt that this system was not serious.

    How can there be any serious system that specifically helps people practice dual cultivation?

    But then I thought about it, it was just a golden finger that I picked up for free. If it’s not serious, then it’s not serious.

    After all, it is still a system, which is better than continuing to be a waste.

    "It has been detected that there is a target with high compatibility nearby - Yu Linglong, with a compatibility of 91%. It is recommended that the host cultivates with her as soon as possible."

    Exquisite jade.

    Isn't that the inner elder of Cangwu Sect?

    The cultivation level of Jin Dan in the later stage is ranked high in the entire Lower Three Prefectures.

    More importantly, she is his master.

    Although it is registered.

    When he was assigned to her sect, she glanced at him and said only one sentence.

    "Third level of Qi refining? Go to the library and read by yourself. Don't bother me."

    From then on, he was her disciple in name, but in fact he could not even see her.

    Now the system asks him to practice dual cultivation with her.
